[ 01 — THE MINDSET ]

“Build the best startup ecosystem in India — and build for the world from India.”

Rishithej is an entrepreneur and strategic leader serving as Managing Director of ML Dynamic Solutions, and as a director and co-founder across VidyuthLabs, Predictera, FirstSecure.ai and DenyFix.ai, alongside board positions at ML Capital and the ML Group of Companies.

With an MSc in Entrepreneurship and Innovation Management from the University of Leicester, he combines deep-tech execution with sovereign ecosystem building — steering DPIIT-recognized ventures and cross-industry enterprises with global compounding impact.
